name: RuntimePack Ren'Py 8 Android Runtime (official RAPT)
description: Official Ren'Py Android Packaging Tool (RAPT) native runtime for arm64-v8a. A single fat shared library that statically links CPython 3.9, SDL2, pygame_sdl2 and the Ren'Py engine (Cython modules). Required by RenpyActivity to boot Ren'Py 8 games such as Mizuki And Me.

licenses.bundled_components: See licenses/NOTICE.txt and licenses/components.json (CPython/PSF, SDL2/zlib, LGPL portions, etc.)

load_align.note: 3 of 4 LOAD segments use p_align=0x1000 (4 KB); the executable LOAD uses p_align=0x4000 (16 KB). Not fully 16 KB page-size aligned as built upstream.

notes: The official RAPT runtime for Android ships ONE fat library per ABI. There is no separate libpython3.9.so / libSDL2*.so / libc++_shared.so on Android; CPython 3.9, SDL2, pygame_sdl2 and libc++ are statically linked into librenpython.so.

Additional ABIs available in the same RAPT archive: armeabi-v7a (26331672 bytes, sha256 2e096754e101c10f20203cd6175dc47bce7dd9cb07d523335e0dcb910b73933a) and x86_64 (32123784 bytes, sha256 858fa3f033a4673f6a13dcd40d0b56a8c0bddcd064e41c5d203efe72ddd3517a). Only arm64-v8a is vendored here.
Ren'Py engine + Python stdlib (renpy/, lib/python3.9) are shipped as game content and are mounted from the packaged content container at runtime; they are not part of this native runtime payload.
